title: Role and Permission Validation
description: Validate page, action, and data permissions across roles, ownership states, and tenant boundaries.
setup_prompt: Use Role and Permission Validation with my authenticated browser foundation. Build an approved actor-resource-action matrix, verify allowed and denied paths including direct navigation, and retain redacted evidence without changing permissions.

setup_inputs.label: Approved resources, actions, and expected decisions
Ownership, tenancy, fixture, and cleanup boundaries

recommended_tools.name: Playwright CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Execute the actor-resource-action matrix in isolated contexts

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks managed agent-browser
recommended_tools.purpose: Investigate permission mismatches and collect supported diagnostics

recommended_tools.name: Identity-provider MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read explicitly authorized non-secret role configuration when available
